note: JRA directly cross-references grass and turf. Grass is retired as a duplicate surface Concept and preserved as a label under SURF-001 Turf.
BHA explicitly describes claim allowances for eligible Amateur, Conditional and Apprentice Riders; poundage and winner thresholds remain licence-specific.
Current NYRA rules use breezing as a training activity and NYRA past-performance guidance uses b = breezing in morning workouts; scope narrowed to North America/Regional.
Current NYRA rules contain a Gate Schooling section and connect the procedure to removal from the Starter's List; scope narrowed to North America/NYRA/Regional.
NYRA and HISA use layoff for a period without racing and define operational reporting thresholds; scope narrowed to North America/USA/Regional.
Current NYRA uses Track Announcer as the official title and Churchill Downs describes the announcer's race-calling function. Seed canonical Race caller is corrected to Track announcer.
